title.narrative: Start Fund Nepal

description.narrative: Start Fund Nepal (SFN) is a rapid-response humanitarian pooled fund providing flexible, anticipatory funding to member organisations responding to under-the-radar and forecastable crises in Nepal.

humanitarian-scope.narrative: Nepal Multi-Hazard Response: Floods, Landslides, Heatwave, Coldwave, and Health Emergencies

policy-marker.narrative: Disaster risk reduction is a principal objective - anticipatory action and preparedness
Gender equality is a significant objective - all data disaggregated by sex

title.narrative: Start Fund Nepal provides a rapid, anticipatory and flexible response to under-the-radar and forecastable crises. Decision-making and programming is member-led, collaborative, and informed by humanitarian and technical expertise and local knowledge.
